title: Training Notes: Qualifying-Spend Waiver on Crestline Companion Fare Retention
content:
A holder's qualifying spend in the Summit program reduces the cancellation retention on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes companion fare refund.

**What is the waiver read from?** From the qualifying dollars credited to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program by qualifying-dollar accrual entries dated in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date. Only qualifying-dollar accrual entries are added up.

**What waiver does each level of spend give?**

| Qualifying dollars from those accrual entries in the last 12 months | Waiver of the cancellation retention |
|---|---|
| 15000 USD or more | 30 percent |
| 5000 USD to less than 15000 USD | 15 percent |
| less than 5000 USD | none |

**Where do the boundaries fall?** Exactly 15000 USD gives 30 percent; 14999.99 USD gives 15 percent. Exactly 5000 USD gives 15 percent; 4999.99 USD gives none.

**Do accruals older than 12 months count?** No. Only qualifying-dollar accrual entries dated within the last 12 months counted back from the handling date are added up.

**Hypothetical example.** Accrual entries of 3200.00, 1400.00 and 900.00 USD in the last 12 months total 5500.00 USD, giving a waiver of 15 percent.
